title: Story premise ENT103: The Planet With a Pause Button
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (fantasy and science fiction). Hook: Pausing the problem paused the solution too. Takeaway/theme: A control can disable useful motion along with the obstacle.
description: A traveler needs to cross a tiny rotating planet to meet a friend, but pressing its pause button also freezes every helpful moving platform. They release pause, learn the visible platform rhythm, and ride the normal cycle around the globe while the friend holds up a patiently rotating welcome flag.
